description: This file defines the EmployeeTimesheetModel class, which is part of the OrangeHRM time API module. It models employee timesheet data for API responses, specifying how to serialize the Timesheet entity into a structured format suitable for API consumption. It includes schema annotations for API documentation, and employs traits for serialization logic.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetModel
classes.description: A model class used to represent employee timesheet data in API responses. It serializes a Timesheet entity into an API-friendly format, including employee details, status, start and end dates.
